# Mosam Biswas

> Portfolio of Mosam Biswas, a software engineer in Navi Mumbai, India, working across AI / ML and full-stack development. A 2026 B.Tech AI & Data Science graduate of RAIT (D. Y. Patil Deemed to be University) with a software internship, a co-authored IEEE paper, and shipped work that ranges from a fully local voice assistant to an AI form-filling Chrome extension. Open to full-time roles and internships.

- Role: Software engineer · AI / ML · Full-stack
- Based in: Navi Mumbai, India (IST, UTC+5:30)
- Status: Open to full-time roles and internships
- Email: mosambiswas999@gmail.com
- Everything on this site in one Markdown file: https://www.mosambiswas.com/llms-full.txt

## Experience

- [Software Developer Intern, Sedna Technologies](https://www.mosambiswas.com/resume.html#experience): Jan / Apr 2026, Mumbai. Shipped work across 4 client projects and built a client-facing dashboard solo (Angular, Flask, MySQL), later submitted as the B.Tech dissertation

## Work

- [AMINAL](https://github.com/BiswasMosam/Aminal-Public): local-first voice assistant for Windows. Speech, LLM intent, vision and text-to-speech fully on-device; 29K lines of Python, 125 commands, 849 tests. Python, Whisper, Ollama. 2026. The code is private; the public repo is the write-up
- [Locals](https://github.com/BiswasMosam/Locals): a town of AI users that test web and Android apps the way real people do, and say where they got stuck. 114 locals from 9 job families, built from published research and marked draft until people in those jobs confirm them; human limits are enforced in code, not the prompt, and everything runs on a local model. Python, Ollama, LLM agents, Playwright. 2026
- [Fill.ai](https://www.mosambiswas.com/Fill.ai/): AI form-filling Chrome extension. Every answer must cite a profile field or it is thrown out; a 121-check end-to-end suite runs in Chrome on every push, and releases go out through CI/CD. JS, Chrome MV3, LLMs. 2026. Source: https://github.com/BiswasMosam/Fill.ai
- [MindFirst](https://github.com/BiswasMosam/Mind-First): mental health screening. A GAD-7 style pre-screen run through a Random Forest decides who takes one of 7 condition tests, then hands back self-help and a doctor booking. Next.js, Flask, Prisma. 2025
- [PixelForge](https://github.com/BiswasMosam/PixelForge): leukemia cell classification on C-NMC at 0.89 ROC-AUC, 84% accuracy and 95% recall; a custom spectral-norm GAN augments scarce data. PyTorch. 2025
- [PixelShift](https://www.mosambiswas.com/PixelShift/): in-browser batch image converter, nothing is uploaded. Vanilla JS, Canvas. 2025. Live
- [Rail Mitra](https://github.com/BiswasMosam/RailMind): railway platform and track optimizer; constraint programming hands back conflict-free schedules. Python, OR-Tools. 2025
- [IntelliStatement](https://github.com/BiswasMosam/LLM-bank-statement-analyzer): LLM bank-statement analyzer, extraction from PDFs and images into structured data. FastAPI, Streamlit. 2025
- [Committee Connect](https://github.com/BiswasMosam/CommitteesManagement): Android app for college committees, a four-person RAIT mini project synced over Firebase. Android, Java. 2024
- [Sim Sim](https://github.com/BiswasMosam/SimSim-Virtual-Assistant): voice-driven AI desktop assistant with 23 commands, from alarms and news to WhatsApp and games. Python, PySide6. 2024
- [Flex Card](https://github.com/BiswasMosam/Flex-Card): Windows app that scans your hardware and exports a share-ready PNG spec card. Python, PyQt5. 2024
- [To-Do](https://www.mosambiswas.com/To-Do/): full-stack task boards with sign-in, Node backend to front end. Node.js, JS. 2024. Live
- [Pops](https://github.com/BiswasMosam/Pops) and [Order Control](https://github.com/BiswasMosam/Order-Control): two offline Android apps for real small businesses, a fabrication firm's order tracker and a food stall order board, on relational SQLite. Flutter, Dart. 2026

## Proof

- [Fill.ai tests](https://github.com/BiswasMosam/Fill.ai/actions/workflows/tests.yml): GitHub Actions runs 44 unit tests and the 121-check end-to-end suite, which loads the real extension into Chrome, on every push. Releases are built by [a second workflow](https://github.com/BiswasMosam/Fill.ai/actions/workflows/publish.yml)
- [Locals tests](https://github.com/BiswasMosam/Locals/actions/workflows/tests.yml): 79 tests on every push, with Fill.ai built beside it so its task cards are checked against the real extension
- [Dacx tests](https://github.com/BiswasMosam/Dacx/actions/workflows/tests.yml): 60 tests and static analysis on every push, including the connection layer against a real local WebSocket server
- [Peghunt tests](https://github.com/BiswasMosam/Peghunt/actions/workflows/tests.yml): 44 tests and static analysis on every push
- [Order Control tests](https://github.com/BiswasMosam/Order-Control/actions/workflows/tests.yml): 13 tests and static analysis on every push
- [Shellfolio tests](https://github.com/BiswasMosam/Shellfolio/actions/workflows/tests.yml): go vet, the tests and the Linux build on every push. The server itself is live: `ssh mosambiswas.com`
- [PixelForge results](https://github.com/BiswasMosam/PixelForge#-results-stage-1): the ROC curve (AUC = 0.89) and the confusion matrix behind the numbers above are in the repository as PDFs, next to the notebook
- Live apps anyone can open: [PixelShift](https://www.mosambiswas.com/PixelShift/), [To-Do](https://www.mosambiswas.com/To-Do/), [Fill.ai's latest release](https://github.com/BiswasMosam/Fill.ai/releases/latest)
- The IEEE paper below is on IEEE Xplore under its DOI

## Research

- [Comparative Analysis of Psychometric Data for Assessing Mental Health Testing Needs Using Machine Learning Models](https://doi.ieeecomputersociety.org/10.1109/ICAIIHI67124.2025.11403838): co-author, IEEE Xplore, Proc. ICAIIHI 2025. Five models benchmarked on 28.5K PHQ-9 / GAD-7 records; Logistic Regression led at 99% accuracy with SHAP explanations
- [The paper as a PDF](https://www.mosambiswas.com/ResearchPaper.pdf)
